review_candidates.title: Director, B2B ICT
review_candidates.description: What's the role? The Director, ICT & Solutions is responsible for leading the B2B ICT growth strategy, solution development, and specialized sales capabilities across the organization. The role leads Pre-Sales & Solution Architecture and the ICT Business Development Managers (BDMs), ensuring that technology capabilities are translated into compelling customer solutions, qualified pipeline, revenue growth and sustainable profitability.   The position acts as the bridge between Sales, Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Technology, Operations, Partners and Customers, and plays a critical role in evolving the B2B organization from a traditional connectivity provider into a trusted technology and managed services partner. Team Scope Pre-Sales & Solution Architecture - responsible for technically sound, commercially competitive and scalable customer solutions. ICT Business Development Managers (BDMs) - specialized sales professionals focused on Cloud, Cybersecurity, Unified Communications & Collaboration (UC&C), IoT, Managed Services, Data Center, SD-WAN/SASE and other advanced ICT solutions. Leadership Expectations Think commercially while maintaining strong technology credibility. Challenge traditional product-selling approaches and drive consultative, solution-based selling. Create strong collaboration between Account Managers, BDMs, Pre-Sales and GTM. Develop talent and build specialized ICT capabilities. Maintain strong execution discipline around pipeline, forecasting and conversion. Simplify complex technologies into clear customer business outcomes. Create accountability for revenue generation across the ICT organization. Build strong relationships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders. Role Mission Accelerate B2B growth by transforming connectivity customer relationships into broader technology partnerships, combining network assets with Cloud, Cybersecurity, UC&C, IoT and Managed Services to increase customer value, ICT penetration, recurring revenue and profitability.   How will you add value? Key Responsibilities 1. ICT Growth Strategy & Business Development Define and execute the B2B ICT growth strategy aligned with the overall B2B commercial plan. Identify priority ICT growth opportunities across customer segments and technology domains. Build and manage the ICT commercial pipeline in partnership with Enterprise, Medium Business and other B2B Sales teams. Establish clear revenue, pipeline, bookings and margin targets by ICT solution domain. Develop account penetration strategies to increase ICT share-of-wallet within the existing connectivity customer base. Identify cross-sell opportunities leveraging the company's Fixed, Mobile and Connectivity customer base. Drive the transition from transactional product selling toward consultative, solution-based selling. Develop strategic initiatives to generate new ICT opportunities and accelerate pipeline conversion. 2. Leadership of ICT Business Development Managers Lead the team of specialized ICT BDMs across Cloud, Cybersecurity, UC&C, Managed Services, IoT, Data Center, SD-WAN/SASE, Network & Infrastructure Solutions and Professional Services. Establish sales targets and KPIs by technology domain. Define account engagement models between BDMs and Account Managers. Ensure BDMs actively generate, qualify, develop and close ICT opportunities alongside the Sales organization. Build joint account plans for strategic customers and develop vertical-specific propositions and use cases. Coach the team on consultative selling and value-based selling methodologies. Monitor individual and team pipeline, conversion, bookings, revenue and margin performance. Ensure BDM resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities and strategic accounts. 3. Pre-Sales & Solution Architecture Leadership Lead the B2B Pre-Sales and Solution Architecture organization. Establish clear governance for opportunity qualification, solution design and technical support throughout the sales cycle. Ensure customer requirements are translated into technically robust and commercially viable solutions. Improve response times and quality for RFPs, RFIs and complex commercial opportunities. Define solution architecture standards and reusable solution designs. Ensure appropriate technical validation, costing, risk assessment and feasibility before commercial proposals are submitted. Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations and Delivery teams to ensure solutions can be successfully implemented and supported. Optimize Pre-Sales resource allocation based on opportunity size, complexity, strategic value and probability of closing. Develop technical capabilities and certifications across the Pre-Sales organization. 4. Sales Enablement & Customer Engagement Act as an executive technology advisor for strategic B2B customers. Participate in executive customer meetings, workshops and complex solution presentations. Lead or support ICT discovery sessions to identify customer business challenges and technology transformation opportunities. Develop repeatable customer use cases and solution playbooks. Equip Account Managers with the knowledge, tools and commercial narratives required to identify ICT opportunities. Develop ICT sales training and certification programs in partnership with GTM and Sales Enablement. Support customer events, technology forums, executive briefings and demand-generation activities. 5. ICT Portfolio & Go-to-Market Support Work closely with the Go-to-Market (GTM) team, which leads the ICT portfolio strategy, product development, value proposition, pricing and commercialization roadmap. Provide customer, market and sales insights to support the GTM team in defining and evolving the ICT portfolio. Identify customer needs, technology trends and portfolio gaps based on direct interaction with customers, Sales, BDMs and Pre-Sales. Support GTM in the development of differentiated ICT value propositions and solutions. Collaborate with GTM in developing integrated propositions combining Connectivity, Mobile, Cloud, Cybersecurity, UC&C, IoT and Managed Services. Provide technical and commercial input into product development, pricing and business cases. Support GTM in defining target customer profiles, priority verticals and relevant ICT use cases. Collaborate in the development of sales plays, solution bundles and commercial propositions. Ensure BDM and Pre-Sales teams are fully enabled on new products, solutions and GTM initiatives. Provide continuous customer and competitive feedback to GTM to support portfolio optimization and roadmap prioritization. Support the execution of ICT product launches and commercial initiatives across the B2B Sales organization. Ownership principle: The GTM team owns the ICT portfolio, product strategy and go-to-market framework, while the Director, ICT & Solutions ensures strong market feedback, technical-commercial validation and effective execution through BDM and Pre-Sales teams. 6. Strategic Technology Partnerships Work in close collaboration with the Go-to-Market team, which leads the strategic development and governance of the ICT partner ecosystem. Support GTM in identifying technology partners required to strengthen or expand the ICT portfolio. Provide technical and commercial input in the evaluation of potential technology partners. Participate in strategic discussions with key technology vendors and partners. Support the development of joint customer solutions and complex opportunities involving strategic partners. Collaborate with GTM on joint business plans, co-selling initiatives and customer engagement activities. Leverage relationships with technology partners to accelerate strategic ICT opportunities. Support GTM in identifying new technologies and capabilities relevant to customer demand. Ensure BDM and Pre-Sales teams maintain the appropriate technical knowledge, certifications and relationships with strategic technology partners. Provide feedback to GTM regarding partner performance, competitiveness and customer experience. Ownership principle: The GTM team owns the strategic partner framework, portfolio partnerships and overall vendor strategy, while the Director, ICT & Solutions leverages those partnerships to develop opportunities, design solutions and accelerate ICT sales. 7. Commercial & Financial Management Own ICT sales performance and contribute directly to B2B revenue and profitability objectives. Manage ICT pipeline, bookings, revenue, gross margin and sales conversion. Establish pipeline coverage targets and forecasting discipline. Monitor performance by technology domain, customer segment and sales channel. Ensure solutions meet minimum profitability and commercial return requirements. Partner with Finance and GTM teams on pricing, business cases and commercial models. Identify opportunities to increase recurring revenue and improve ICT revenue mix.   What do you need? Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Business or related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of experience in B2B Telecommunications, ICT, Technology Services, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Managed Services or related industries. 5+ years of leadership experience managing commercial, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Business Development or ICT teams. Demonstrated track record of delivering ICT revenue growth. Strong understanding of Enterprise and Mid-Market B2B customers and complex ICT sales cycles. Strong knowledge of several ICT domains including Cloud, Cybersecurity, UC&C, Managed Services, IoT, Data Center, Networking and SD-WAN/SASE. Experience working with technology partner ecosystems and vendors. Strong commercial and financial acumen, including pricing, margin management and business-case development. Experience in a telecommunications operator, systems integrator, managed services provider or major technology company is highly desirable. Excellent executive communication, negotiation and presentation skills. Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
